div.div: حَدْمٌ and ↓ حَدَمٌ The vehement burning of fire, (K,) and of heat: or, accord. to the T, حدم [app. حَدْمٌ] signifies the vehement heating of a thing by the sun, and by fire: [see 1:] accord. to AZ, زَفْرُ النَّارِ signifies “ the flaming, or blazing, of fire; ” and شَهِيقُهَا and حَدْمُهَا and حَمْدُهَا and كَلْحَبَتُهَا have all one meaning [app. the third of the meanings assigned below to حَدَمَةٌ]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
